negative_cases.name: Interval not derived from declared TV ball
negative_cases.mutation: Change lower or upper away from clipped p±rho

negative_cases.name: Forecast missing interval bounds
negative_cases.mutation: Set a forecast lower bound to null

negative_cases.name: Interval emitted on abstention
negative_cases.mutation: Set abstention lower or upper to a number

negative_cases.name: Missing review fallback
negative_cases.mutation: Set reviewer fallback null on an abstention

negative_cases.name: Proposal probability invalid
negative_cases.mutation: Set proposal stratum probability to zero

negative_cases.name: Sampling design drift
negative_cases.mutation: Change target probability for one case

negative_cases.name: Decision profile threshold drift
negative_cases.mutation: Alter threshold without changing cost/loss terms

negative_cases.name: Invalid loss order
negative_cases.mutation: Set event loss with action >= loss without action

boundary_cases.name: Point and interval collapsed at cost-loss threshold
boundary_cases.expected_disposition: nominal and robust expected choose prepare (inclusive); minimax regret tie chooses no_action

boundary_cases.name: Worst-case expected loss equality
boundary_cases.mutation: Set upper exactly equal to decision threshold

round_trip_requirements: Preserve pinned NRES-011 source fixture blob SHA and source-case count.
Preserve source_case_id and NRES-010 source case lineage.
Preserve candidate point probability, interval lower/upper and total-variation radius exactly.
Preserve regime-specific ambiguity radii and the Bernoulli total-variation definition.
Preserve evaluator-owned outcomes, qualification and reviewer fallback separately from candidate forecasts.
Preserve proposal/target stratum probabilities and derived importance weights.
Preserve every decision profile cost/loss parameter and threshold.
Preserve strategy-specific costs, worst-case regret, decision counts and baseline costs.
limitations: This is a Bernoulli total-variation ambiguity set; it is not a full Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization implementation.
The synthetic ambiguity radii are declared stress parameters, not statistical confidence levels.
The public cases are linked to NRES-011 and are not independent validation data.
The robust policy may incur higher realized costs in the observed public fixture; worst-case guarantees and realized-sample outcomes are separate quantities.
No real-world safety, causal effect, operational readiness or SOTA superiority is claimed.
